title: Chess boxing strikes the perfect balance between mind and body.
author: Many_Track4519
selftext:
This is Street Chess Boxing, a retro arcade game where you play 30 seconds of chess, then spend 20 seconds in the ring. Your position and clocks are right where you left them when you return to the board, and any damage you take carries into the next fight. A checkmate or a knockout can end the match.

It’s free, and you can play without an account. Send a friend an invite link for a private match, or play solo against a bot. If you sign in, you can earn XP against the bot and climb the Elo leaderboard through eligible matchmaking games against other signed-in players.

The game is built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The Android app packages the same client with Capacitor, so browser and Android players can face each other. Cloudflare Durable Objects handle matchmaking and run online matches. Players send chess moves and boxing inputs over WebSockets, and the server validates them and broadcasts the game state. On Expert, Stockfish Lite runs in a Web Worker so the chess AI can think without blocking the interface.

\- Play in your browser: [https://streetchessboxing.com](https://streetchessboxing.com)

\- Join the Android playtest: [https://groups.google.com/g/streetchessboxing](https://groups.google.com/g/streetchessboxing)

\- Leave feedback: [https://forms.gle/gdLFWsx9yVzD4kAv9](https://forms.gle/gdLFWsx9yVzD4kAv9)

Cheers!
